light_description: Dual-channel hand-made overdrive with independent drive sections, designed for clean-to-medium gain and stackable amplifier-style breakup.
Single-channel overdrive derived from the King of Tone family, covering boost, overdrive and higher-gain distortion with multiple clipping voices.
Fuzz Face-style fuzz available with germanium or silicon devices, emphasizing dynamic cleanup, touch response and vintage fuzz character.
High-gain germanium fuzz built around a buzzy mid-1960s character, capable of spitty, aggressive fuzz and classic fuzz-face-like sounds.
Germanium Tone Bender-style fuzz with thick sustain, pronounced harmonic texture and vintage-style cleanup from the guitar volume.
Germanium multi-transistor Tone Bender-style fuzz with a broad, sustaining response and strong vintage British fuzz character.
Combined germanium fuzz and treble booster pedal pairing a Sun Face-style fuzz section with a Beano Boost-style gain stage.
Germanium treble booster designed to add upper-mid presence, gain and amplifier drive in the classic Rangemaster tradition.
Asymmetric overdrive built around a low-to-medium gain response with articulate clipping and amplifier-pushing applications.
Compact distortion built for Marshall-style hard rock gain, with control over sub frequencies and a broad range from crunch to heavy distortion.
High-gain distortion with pronounced low-end thump, extensive tone control and a switchable noise gate for tight heavy sounds.
Interactive germanium fuzz with a proximity-controlled stability circuit capable of oscillation, unstable cleanup and extreme fuzzy textures.
Compact fuzz with a simple control set, capable of thick saturated fuzz and octave-like gated textures with a strong low-end character.
High-gain silicon fuzz with impedance, pulse-width and tone controls that move from thick fuzz into gated, synth-like and octave-rich textures.
Amplifier-style distortion built around the character of a cranked British stack, with gain and tone shaping for crunchy through saturated sounds.
Two-channel configurable drive platform that can combine Distortron, Super Hard-On and Box of Rock-style signal paths for cascading gain and boost.
Dual booster built from two Super Hard-On-style stages, ranging from clean level lift to bright, driven boost and stacked overdrive.
Small-format gain stage derived from the second channel of the Super Duper, moving from buffer and unity gain to light transparent overdrive.
High-headroom booster with a bright, responsive gain character that can push an amplifier from clean boost into gritty overdrive.
Octave-up fuzz with a flexible control set capable of thick fuzz, pronounced upper-octave harmonics and aggressive saturated textures.
Bass-oriented distortion designed to add aggressive saturated gain while retaining enough low-frequency authority for bass applications.
Bender-style fuzz with a vintage British voice, providing thick harmonic saturation, sustain and responsive cleanup.
Gated fuzz designed around sharp, biting textures that can move from usable distortion-like grit into sputtery and broken-up fuzz.
Muff-style gated fuzz combining thick low-end saturation with more aggressive gating and tonal shaping.
BC183-based silicon fuzz voiced for vintage-inspired saturation with strong harmonic detail and a responsive gain character.
Multi-voiced silicon octave-up fuzz offering several upper-harmonic characters from focused octave tones to thicker full-range fuzz.
Polyphonic octave fuzz and modulation pedal producing layered octave textures, dense fuzz and animated upper-harmonic effects.
Low-to-mid gain overdrive with asymmetric clipping and active tonal contouring, ranging from sweet boost-like drive to British-leaning growl.
Mid-focused preamp and overdrive with a broad gain range from clear boost to thicker drive and stackable amplifier push.
Dynamic projector-inspired overdrive with tube-like response, dual gain/volume sets and a higher-gain mode for thicker saturation.
Five-state overdrive offering distinct clipping voices from clean, sparkly gain through smooth and compressed heavier overdrive.
Five-state fuzz with a voltage control that can move from open, massive fuzz to sputtery, gated and starved textures.
Tube-assisted fuzz combining thick, sustaining saturation with a harmonic overtone circuit for richer chord and rhythmic textures.
Aggressive distortion and reverb combination using a joystick for interactive control of gain and ambience, with switchable signal order.
High-gain distortion voiced for saturated rock and modern lead tones with active tonal shaping and strong sustain.
High-gain distortion with multiple clipping modes and tone control, ranging from tight rhythm drive to dense saturated distortion.
Dynamic distortion reissue with broad gain response, moving from gritty overdrive-like breakup toward compressed heavier distortion.
Silicon fuzz with a thick, harmonically rich response and control over bass and mids for fuller or more cutting fuzz textures.
